summary: Describes a solution for customers of a single ISP who use BGP4 but do not need their own allocated AS, following RFC 1930. The provider can use a dedicated AS for such sites. It is informational.

eli5.summary: Some small customers use a routing system that needs an ID number. This lets a provider share one ID among many small customers instead of giving each their own.

questions: when to use a private as number
how to use bgp with a single isp
